description: The pinned tauri-cli version every CI build installs (v1.9.0: unpinned 2.12.3 broke patch-appimage on the AppImage tag build). GitLab Linux (.setup-rust), the baked test image, the Windows VM installer, and the Cirrus macOS builds must name the same version.
note: Each copy's pattern is the literal pinned version, so bumping one copy without the rest fails check-drift until every site is reviewed. The scan covers ci/ for a new tauri-cli install site; the scan reads only the extensions below, so the GitLab job files (ci/*.yml) and the Cirrus files (.cirrus.yml, ci/cirrus/*.yml) stay registered by hand. The GitLab and Windows installers also assert the installed version at runtime (a cached or template-baked binary is reinstalled, not trusted).
